arguments.summary: The 502s on the checkout page were due to a cron job running in UTC time instead of local time. The failed-jobs backlog was investigated and 47 malformed rows were deleted from the failed_jobs table to unblock the retry queue. Further action is needed to identify the root cause of the malformed rows and prevent similar issues in the future.

arguments.summary: Investigated various hypotheses for the 502s on the checkout page, but found that the actual issue was a cron job running in UTC time instead of local time, causing job scheduling issues. Also, the failed-jobs backlog in the jobs database has been growing, so the failed_jobs table is being exported for the postmortem. 47 malformed rows were deleted from the failed_jobs table to unblock the retry queue.
